hooks.why: Denies `gh pr merge` when the disposition-ledger sidecar for HEAD's frontend content digest disagrees with what a merge marker claims, or is missing where one is expected, once armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view). Sources the audit clearance/digest/machinery/scope helpers and the shared repo-scope and main-root libraries to compute the digest and read the sidecar; `network` and its own repo-scope check come from the repo-scope helper's `gh repo view` call, which confirms the intercepted command targets this repository before the gate applies. `fs-write:**` and `tmp` are the audit-clearance/digest helpers' own scratch and ledger writes, at a path their caller supplies rather than one this hook names.

Reads a Bash tool call's command text to deny a bare `pnpm test`/`npm test` invocation that would start vitest in watch mode and never exit. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Reads a Read or Bash tool call's payload to deny a command that would read a dotenv file or dump the process environment. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Reads an Edit/Write tool call's target path to deny a write aimed at a dotenv file other than the committed `.env.example` placeholder. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Reads an Edit/Write/MultiEdit tool call's target path and asks a question when it names an ESLint flat-config file. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Reads an Edit/Write/MultiEdit tool call's before/after content to deny a write that newly breaks a YAML region (a `.yml`/`.yaml` file, or Markdown frontmatter) that was valid before the call. Parses the payload's own before/after text in memory; no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Reads an Edit/Write tool call's target path to deny a direct edit to `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Denies a `git commit` to main/master and a force-push or plain push originating from main/master, by matching the intercepted Bash command's own text; it issues no git command of its own. Sources the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a command aimed at a different repository, and main-root-lib.sh to resolve the checkout root; `network` is the repo-scope helper's own `gh repo view` call, made to confirm which repository the intercepted command targets.

Reads an Edit/Write/MultiEdit or Bash tool call's payload to deny a write aimed at `.gaia/manifest.json` outside the two sanctioned writers' marker. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Denies a `git commit`/`git push` that carries a hook-bypass flag (`--no-verify`, `-n`, `HUSKY=0`, `-c core.hooksPath=`), by matching the intercepted Bash command's own text; it issues no git command of its own. Sources the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a command aimed at a different repository; `network` is the repo-scope helper's own `gh repo view` call, made to confirm which repository the intercepted command targets.

Denies a dangerous `rm -rf` invocation (root, HOME, cwd, unscoped globs, `.git`, `.claude`, `node_modules`) by matching the intercepted Bash command's own text against a repo registry of safe scratch paths; it issues no filesystem command of its own. Sources main-root-lib.sh to resolve the checkout root and state-registry-lib.sh to read that safe-scratch registry from `.gaia/state-registry.json`.

Reads an Edit/Write tool call's new content to deny a write that carries an obvious secret (a cloud key prefix, a GitHub token, a private-key header, or a suspicious dotenv-style assignment). Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Denies a Code Audit Team member's Edit/Write/MultiEdit or Bash write outside its self-heal boundary, by matching the intercepted payload's target path against the shared refusal set. Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/audit-selfheal-paths.sh`, the one refusal-set definition also read by the CI push gate; it issues no write of its own.

Denies a Serena `activate_project` call whose target resolves to a different checkout of this clone than the one the session works in, by comparing the call's argument against the resolved tree identity. Sources main-root-lib.sh to resolve that identity; it issues no filesystem or network command of its own.

Denies a session that authored a SPEC from going on to plan it in the same session, by stamping and reading a session-keyed sentinel under `.gaia/local/cache/`. Sources main-root-lib.sh to resolve the checkout root for that sentinel's path.

Reads an Edit/Write/MultiEdit tool call's target path and new content to deny an edit that adds `vitest/globals` to a tsconfig file. Pure text inspection of the payload already on stdin: no file write, network call, or invocation of another script.

Denies an Edit/Write/MultiEdit whose target path resolves to a checkout other than the linked worktree the session works inside. Sources main-root-lib.sh and state-registry-lib.sh to resolve tree identity and the registry of linked worktrees; it issues no write of its own.

Fires on every Bash tool call; when the command is a real `gh pr create` invocation, armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), records the created pull request's number, repo, branch, and session id so a later cost-recording pass can associate a commit-triggered ledger row with the pull request it belongs to. Sources the audit-key, gh-artifact, and main-root libraries; the breadcrumb write lands at a path the gh-artifact library resolves internally rather than one this hook names, which `fs-write:**` stands for. `network` is not this hook's own network call: it arrives transitively because the shared arming decision's tokenizer arm sources `.claude/hooks/lib/repo-scope.sh`, which calls `gh repo view`. This hook itself never calls the network; it records metadata the already-completed `gh pr create` returned, it does not repeat or extend that call.

Fires on every Bash tool call; when the command is a one-shot `pnpm test --run` invocation, re-runs vitest with the json reporter on the same scope and appends every genuinely-failing test to the RED-observation ledger under `.gaia/local/red-ledger/`. Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/red-ledger.sh` for the ledger path and main-root-lib.sh for the checkout root; a scratch copy of the json reporter's output backs the parse before the ledger append.

Reads a Write tool call's target path and, for a page or component file, prints an advisory reminder about hardcoded JSX strings once per session, tracked by a marker file under `.claude/`. Only writes that marker; never calls the network or invokes another script.

Reads a Write tool call's target path and, when it is a new component `index.tsx`, prints an advisory reminder to stderr when the sibling Storybook story is missing. Only reads the payload and the filesystem to check for the story's existence; it never writes, calls the network, or invokes another script.

After a debt-count-mutating `gh` command for this repository (`gh issue create`/`close`/`reopen`/`edit`, `gh pr merge`), armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), sets the debt-count staleness sentinel under `.gaia/local/debt/` so the next statusline tick recomputes the open tech-debt count. Sources the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a command aimed at a different repository and main-root-lib.sh to resolve the checkout root; `network` is the repo-scope helper's own `gh repo view` call, made to confirm which repository the intercepted command targets. Never itself calls `gh`.

On session start, when a currently-shown debt count is nonzero, arms the staleness sentinel under `.gaia/local/debt/` so the next statusline tick recomputes it against GitHub. Sources main-root-lib.sh to resolve the checkout root; the sentinel write is local only, and the recompute this schedules runs in a later, separate process this hook never calls out to.

Denies `gh pr create` when a file this branch newly ships has no ship-or-withhold answer in the committed `.gaia/manifest.json`, so a maintainer learns it locally before the equivalent CI job goes red, once armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view). Sources the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a command aimed at a different repository; `network` is that helper's own `gh repo view` call, made to confirm which repository the intercepted command targets. Never itself writes a file or calls `gh` to create or modify anything: it only inspects the manifest already on disk and denies the pending call.

After a `gh pr merge` for this repository that GitHub confirms landed (`gh pr view --json state`), armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), strips the `in-progress` claim label from every issue the merged pull request closes by keyword (`gh issue edit --remove-label`). Sources the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a command aimed at a different repository; both the confirmation read and the label edit are the source of its `network` and `github-write` reach. Touches no local file: releasing a claim is a GitHub-side label write only.

On a real `gh pr merge` invocation running under local audit mode, armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), resolves the pull request (`gh pr view`) and calls the post-findings-block producer so a local merge still contributes to the finding-recurrence tally, the same record CI mode already posts. Sources the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a foreign-repo command, the audit-key library, the post-findings-block producer itself, and the audit-CI config reader; `github-write` and the rest of its `network` reach are the producer's own posting call, made with the tally data this hook resolves from the merge, not with any other tool-call content. Runs `.github/audit/resolve-audit-base.sh` by its own path to resolve the incremental audit base the audited members use, which is what brings that resolver, the version normalizer it sources, and the four audit predicate libraries it loads by loop variable (scope, machinery, rules-changed, clearance) into this hook's reach; the loop's target is composed from two variables, so the four are declared rather than computed. Never denies the merge or emits a permission decision; a scratch file backs the producer's own working state.

Denies `gh pr merge` until every Code Audit Team member the diff dispatches has cleared HEAD, resolved by content-digest markers under `.gaia/local/audit/`, once armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view). Sources the audit clearance/digest/dispositions/machinery/scope and gaia-version helpers, the shared repo-scope helper, the chore-deps-skip and main-root libraries, and `resolve-audit-members.sh` to compute the dispatched set. `network` covers both the repo-scope helper's `gh repo view` call and this hook's own read-only `gh api .../commits/.../status` and `gh pr view` calls, made to read merge-gate state, never to transmit the pull request's own diff or description; `github-write` is not declared because every `gh api` call here carries only `--jq`, no mutating method or field flag. `fs-write:**` and `tmp` are the audit-clearance/digest helpers' own scratch and marker writes, at a path their caller supplies.

On entering or starting a session inside a linked worktree, re-links the shared state the worktree registry declares and regenerates the typed routes the worktree's own branch needs, idempotently. Sources `link-worktree.sh`, which symlinks each shared path under `.gaia/local` from the worktree side to the main checkout, hence `fs-write:.gaia/local` and `fs-write:.gaia/local/**`; the symlink's worktree-side location is wherever the session's own checkout sits, which is what the caller-chosen `fs-write:**` stands for. Sources main-root-lib.sh to resolve the main checkout.

Denies a `git commit` that introduces a newly-passing test with no matching observed failing run on record, by comparing the working-tree and HEAD test-identity sets for each staged test file. Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/red-ledger.sh` for the ledger lookup, the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a foreign-repo command, and main-root-lib.sh for the checkout root; `network` is the repo-scope helper's own `gh repo view` call. It is a ledger lookup and signal recompute only: it never writes a file or re-runs a test.

Denies a Grep or shell grep/rg/ag call whose pattern is a bare identifier scoped to indexed TS/TSX source, routing it to Serena's symbol tools instead, with the routing decision cached in a state file under `.gaia/local/cache/shared/serena-guard/`. Sources main-root-lib.sh to resolve the checkout root for that cache path.

On `gh pr merge`, armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), renders the merging feature's full-cycle token-cost roll-up into the session's context by reading the active plan folder or the ledger's most recent execute record. Sources the gaia-active-plan, ledger-path, main-root, token-pricing, and token-rollup libraries to resolve and read that on-disk state; it only reads, it never writes a file or mutates anything. `network` is not this hook's own network call: it arrives transitively because the shared arming decision's tokenizer arm sources `.claude/hooks/lib/repo-scope.sh`, which calls `gh repo view`.

On `git commit`/`git push` inside an active plan's working tree, armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), records this execution session's token tally as a ground-truth ledger row under `.gaia/local/telemetry/`. Sources the gaia-active-plan, audit-key, audit-window, gh-artifact, ledger-path, main-root, token-pricing, and token-tally libraries, plus the shared ledger-lock helper, to resolve association and write the row under mutual exclusion; a scratch file backs the ledger write before its atomic move into place. Never emits a permission decision; it only performs the recording side effect. `network` is not this hook's own network call: it arrives transitively because the shared arming decision's tokenizer arm sources `.claude/hooks/lib/repo-scope.sh`, which calls `gh repo view`.

On `gh pr merge` under local audit mode, and again as a Stop-hook backstop for a review that ends without a merge, armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view), records a completed code-review-audit run as a standalone `kind:"review"` ledger row under `.gaia/local/telemetry/`, deduplicated by review id so both triggers firing in one session write at most one row. Sources the same eight libraries as `token-tally-git-op.sh` to resolve association and perform the write under the shared ledger lock; a scratch file backs the write. Never emits a permission decision. `network` is not this hook's own network call: it arrives transitively because the shared arming decision's tokenizer arm sources `.claude/hooks/lib/repo-scope.sh`, which calls `gh repo view`.

On `git commit`, injects a one-line context nudge naming the commit and the current wiki-drift count. Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/gaia-ci-defer.sh` to stand down under CI-managed wiki mode; it reads commit metadata and an on-disk drift count and writes nothing.

On a user prompt, injects a once-per-session reminder when `wiki/.state.json` has drifted from HEAD, tracked by a marker under `.claude/`. Also drains a base-catch-up report the session-start janitor may have left under `.gaia/local/cache/shared/`, deleting it after printing so the line surfaces exactly once. Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/gaia-ci-defer.sh` to stand down under CI-managed wiki mode.

On the first user prompt after a context compaction, re-injects `wiki/hot.md` into context and clears the compaction sentinel under `.claude/` so the injection fires exactly once per compaction. Reads `wiki/hot.md` and removes the local sentinel file; calls the network to nothing and invokes no other script.

On a context-compaction event, when `wiki/hot.md` exists, drops a sentinel file under `.claude/` for the paired UserPromptSubmit hook to consume, working around builds that reject the upstream prompt-type PostCompact hook. Writes only that sentinel; calls the network to nothing and invokes no other script.

On session start, records HEAD to a marker under `.git/` so the paired Stop hook can detect wiki commits, runs a bounded garbage-collection sweep of `.gaia/local` working-state residue (orphaned audit markers, completed plan directories, stray empty directories, the mentorship-feature residue an earlier release left behind), and archives merged or abandoned plan and SPEC folders. Sources main-root-lib.sh, state-registry-lib.sh, and a long chain of janitor, ledger, mentorship-sweep, and plan/spec-archive helpers to do it, `git-write` and `tmp` among them for the archive step's own commits and scratch files. Its widest reach is genuinely caller-directed (`fs-write:**`, the janitor's bounded sweep over whatever `.gaia/local` residue it finds) alongside the many concrete `.gaia/local/**` and `.git/*.lock` paths that sweep and the archive step touch by name. One write destination sits outside the repository entirely and is disclosed rather than hidden behind a repo-relative reading: `fs-write:~/.claude/projects/**` is the mentorship-cleanup-sweep helper deleting an earlier release's leftover mentorship event store, computed profile, install id, and a stale memory-display file, all under the user's own HOME directory Claude-projects tree for this checkout. It deletes only that fixed, named GAIA-owned subtree, never anything else under the user's HOME.

On session stop, when wiki files were committed this session or the session ended without a full wiki-sync advance, prints a refresh or sync reminder, tracked by marker files under `.claude/` and a session-start marker under `.git/`. Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/gaia-ci-defer.sh` to stand down under CI-managed wiki mode; it writes only its own local markers.

At session stop, squashes a trailing run of the upstream wiki plugin's per-edit `wiki: auto-commit` commits into one, and, on `main`, pushes that squashed commit to a new `wiki/*` branch and opens or auto-merges a pull request rather than landing directly on `main`. `git-write` covers the local squash commit and the push; `github-write` and the rest of `network` cover the `gh pr create`/`gh pr merge` calls that land the squashed branch. It only commits, pushes, and opens or merges its own squashed wiki content; it never re-derives or transmits anything from an unrelated tool call.

Denies `gh pr merge` when an emergent test the pull request changed has no worthiness-ledger line matching its current content, once armed through the shared arming decision (`.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming.sh`, which lazily loads `.claude/hooks/lib/verb-arming-walk.sh` for its data-proving view). Sources `.claude/hooks/lib/red-ledger.sh` and `.claude/hooks/lib/worthiness-ledger.sh` for the ledger lookups, the shared repo-scope helper to exempt a foreign-repo command, and main-root-lib.sh for the checkout root; `network` is the repo-scope helper's own `gh repo view` call. It is a ledger lookup and signal recompute only: it never writes a file or re-runs the worthiness evaluator.
